info.name: Personal Vault
info.description:
API collection for the Personal Vault application.

How to use:
1. Import this file into Postman
2. Create an environment with variable: base_url = http://localhost:8000
3. After login (Phase 4), the token is saved automatically into {{token}}

This collection grows with every phase.

request.description:
Check if the server is running and the database is reachable.

Expected response:
{
  "status": "ok",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "database": "connected"
}
